title: L’Archivio dell’Università Ca’ Foscari Venezia
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: A guide to get to know, protect and make usable the documentation produced and collected by Ca' Foscari University Venice since its foundation (1868), as well as an indispensable tool for reconstructing its history and that of the people who have been part of it. In addition to the inventory of its archival fonds, the volume offers a series of useful accompanying tools: from the list of the regulatory sources that have marked its transformations to the description of the personal fonds that have become part of its patrimony, from a substantial bibliography to an annotated guide to the archives of its founding bodies. All illustrated by an apparatus of almost three hundred photographs taken from its collections.
